name: PureLove ~Watashi no Kare wa Geinoujin~
source: Hey you~ Pretty lady over there. Do you want to debut in the Japanese entertainment industry? Debut on the stage of love to purify the darkness and the lies, and fill the entertainment industry with your pureness!
translation: Hey you~ Pretty lady over there. Do you want to debut in the Japanese entertainment industry? Debut on the stage of love to purify the darkness and the lies, and fill the entertainment industry with your pureness!
